result.justification: The objectives are stated, focusing on evaluating the combined effect of lime and gypsum on soil acidity and maize yield. However, while the methodology includes a range of treatments and data collection procedures, it lacks specific details on some key elements such as sample size or full analytical protocols.

evidence.quote: Therefore, this study aimed to evaluate the combined effect of lime and gypsum application on ameliorating soil acidity and grain yield of maize in Hurumu district Southwest Ethiopia.
Treatments were laid out in a randomized complete block design (RCBD) with three replications.
